methods.comment:

methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the largest element in {@code array} that is less than (or optionally * equal to) a specified {@code value}. * *

If false then the returned index corresponds to the largest element strictly less * than the value. * @param stayInBounds If true, then 0 will be returned in the case that the value is smaller than * the smallest element in the array. If false then -1 will be returned. * @return The index of the largest element in {@code array} that is less than (or optionally * equal to) {@code value}.
